messages.author: ba94c8bdf8922e8b
messages.subject: plot output images a specific size?
parts:
Is there a way to output images from plot builder at a specific size?  e.g. 800x600?

Thank you

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: plot output images a specific size?
parts:
The easiest way is to copy the call from the “View Call” menu item, and then manually create the file in the console.

png(“example.png”,width=800,height=600)

<...the code from view call...>

dev.off()

best,
Ian

Hi all,

I have set up a line of code to use a "batch" approach to run repetitive runs using a large number of data sets.
The results are easily then written as a CSV table.

BatDistance<- Deducer::descriptive.table (vars = d (BatDistance),data= BatDistance,func.names =c("Valid N","Minimum","Maximum","Median","Mean","St. Deviation","25th Percentile","75th Percentile"),func.additional= list(p10=function(x) quantile(x, c(0.10), na.rm=TRUE),p90=function(x) quantile(x, c(0.90), na.rm=TRUE)))

## Then write the results Change output name and directory for stats.
write.csv(BatDistance,file="C:\\CLN_Bat Project\\Bufered_mine data 2016\\Distance_Stats.csv")


Where/how can I add a "Stratify by" line to the above?

The data frame will always be assigned to BatDistance using BatDistance<-data table
The DF / table read in has 2 columns Bat,distance

I need to stratify the results by Bat so that the CSV table will have rows with the "Stratified by" Bat and columns will have the descriptive stats.

Must be simple to add that?

Cheers,

Bruce
